hypotheses.title: 60-Day Options Put-to-Call Volume Ratio Contrarian Squeeze with Liquidity Dampening
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Put-to-call trading volume ratio (pcr_vol_60) captures tactical speculative sentiment and institutional tail-hedging surges across 60-day options expirations. When retail traders and hedgers panic-buy puts (pcr_vol_60 spikes), options market makers absorb the inventory. Once the hedging surge exhausts, market makers unwind delta hedges and fear premiums collapse, triggering systematic contrarian short squeezes. Cross-sectional z-score scaling across market ensures uniform weights. Paired with volume-to-adv20 dampening to filter out crowded execution anomalies.
confounders: Fundamental insolvency where elevated put volume correctly anticipates bankruptcy or delisting
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high put volume equities continue to underperform without experiencing relief rebounds.

hypotheses.title: 60-Day PCR Volume Contrarian Alpha with Intraday Close-to-Open Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines medium-term options volume contrarian positioning with 3-day close-to-open body reversal ((close - open) / open). Intraday close-to-open reversal captures overnight order imbalances and liquidity provision compensation without sharing any overlap with intraday VWAP microstructure signals, ensuring zero self-correlation against active portfolio alphas.
confounders: Persistent overnight earnings gaps where open-to-close momentum carries over multiple days
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if close-to-open reversal increases turnover without improving Sharpe ratio.

hypotheses.title: 60-Day PCR Volume Sentiment with 5-Day Price Delta Low-Churn Rebalancing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Uses percentile ranking with 5-day price-delta mean-reversion rebalancing. 5-day price delta operates at lower frequency than intraday signals, reducing daily portfolio turnover into the 12-15% range while preserving the contrarian options volume information coefficient, directly maximizing the Fitness denominator.
confounders: Strong directional momentum trends where 5-day price reversals generate adverse selection
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if price delta rebalancing dampens sub-universe Sharpe below platform cutoff.
